title: Rate and Annual Fee Schedule for FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit
content:
FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit carry a variable APR built on a published index, with a tier margin, a tier floor and a common cap, and an annual fee that differs by tier.

## Rates

| Tier | Margin over the index (percentage points) | APR floor | APR cap | AutoPay APR reduction (percentage points) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FlexLine Starter | 21.49 | 24.99% | 35.99% | 0.25 |
| FlexLine Standard | 17.99 | 19.99% | 35.99% | 0.25 |
| FlexLine Plus | 14.49 | 15.99% | 35.99% | 0.25 |
| FlexLine Preferred | 11.49 | 12.99% | 35.99% | 0.25 |
| FlexLine Premier | 8.99 | 10.99% | 35.99% | 0.25 |
| FlexLine Elite | 6.49 | 8.99% | 35.99% | 0.25 |

For all six tiers:

- **Index**: Prime Rate published in The Wall Street Journal on the last business day of the month before the billing cycle.
- **When an index change takes effect**: first day of the billing cycle after the index change.
- **How interest is charged**: average daily balance (draws accrue from the draw date; no grace period) times the APR divided by 365 times the days in the billing cycle, charged at statement closing.
- **Prepayment penalty**: 0.00 USD on every tier.

## Annual fee

| Tier | Annual fee (USD) | First anniversary fee waived |
|---|---|---|
| FlexLine Starter | 49 | No |
| FlexLine Standard | 39 | No |
| FlexLine Plus | 29 | Yes |
| FlexLine Preferred | 0 | Yes |
| FlexLine Premier | 0 | Yes |
| FlexLine Elite | 0 | Yes |

## Schedule notes

1. *Margin* — Percentage points added to the Prime Rate to set the variable APR.
2. *Floor* — Lowest APR the line can carry, percent. *Cap* — Highest APR the line can carry, percent.
3. *AutoPay reduction* — APR reduction while AutoPay is active, percentage points.
4. *Annual fee* — Annual fee charged on each anniversary of the open date, USD. *First-year waiver* — Whether the annual fee is not charged on the first anniversary.
5. *Prepayment penalty* — Penalty for paying the balance early, USD.

**Hypothetical illustration of margin, floor and cap.** With an index of 4.00% (an assumed figure), FlexLine Plus gives 4.00 plus 14.49, that is 18.49%, which is above its 15.99% floor and below the 35.99% cap; FlexLine Starter gives 4.00 plus 21.49, that is 25.49%, above its 24.99% floor. With an assumed index of 2.00%, FlexLine Starter's sum of 23.49% is below its floor, so the floor of 24.99% is the figure that holds.
